projects.title: Vehicle Price Prediction & Customer Segmentation
projects.description: Trained a Random Forest + Gradient Boosting ensemble on 800,000+ records with iterative feature engineering, achieving an R² of 0.96 on price prediction. Applied K-Means and hierarchical clustering to segment customers, translating segments into clearly differentiated, data-backed pricing tiers.
projects.longDescription: Trained a Random Forest + Gradient Boosting ensemble on 800,000+ records with iterative feature engineering, achieving an R² of 0.96 on price prediction. Applied K-Means and hierarchical clustering to segment customers, translating segments into clearly differentiated, data-backed pricing tiers.

projects.title: Az National Trucking: Big Data Governance Pipeline
projects.description: Built a big data governance pipeline for a trucking company lacking centralized visibility across 100+ drivers, loading 8,000+ GPS records into Hadoop with Hive and Impala, and building Tableau dashboards that reduced route time by 12%.
projects.longDescription: Built a big data governance pipeline for a trucking company lacking centralized visibility across 100+ drivers, loading 8,000+ GPS records into Hadoop with Hive and Impala, and building Tableau dashboards that reduced route time by 12%.

projects.title: Ride-Share Operations Dashboard
projects.description: Modeled booking trends, revenue patterns, and trip behavior across payment types and vehicle categories, building KPI cards and DAX measures that surface core operational metrics. Designed time-series views — 10-minute-interval demand curves, day-of-week trends, and hourly heatmaps — exposing peak-demand patterns for operations planning.
projects.longDescription: Modeled booking trends, revenue patterns, and trip behavior across payment types and vehicle categories, building KPI cards and DAX measures that surface core operational metrics. Designed time-series views — 10-minute-interval demand curves, day-of-week trends, and hourly heatmaps — exposing peak-demand patterns for operations planning.

projects.title: Cohort Analysis
projects.description: Customer cohort analysis in Python and pandas that groups users by their first-purchase period and tracks retention and repeat behavior over time, adapted to work with Elasticsearch data via the eland library.
projects.longDescription: Customer cohort analysis in Python and pandas that groups users by their first-purchase period and tracks retention and repeat behavior over time, adapted to work with Elasticsearch data via the eland library.

projects.title: Real-Time Financial Analysis & Trading System
projects.description: A real-time financial analysis and trading system that ingests and processes live market data to power automated analytics and trading decisions, packaged as a containerized multi-service application.
projects.longDescription: A real-time financial analysis and trading system that ingests and processes live market data to power automated analytics and trading decisions, packaged as a containerized multi-service application.

projects.title: Dynamic Player Manager
projects.description: A player management and roster-optimization system for the Boston Bruins that combines SQL and MongoDB to track player statistics and recommends the best lineup based on performance, opponent strength, and venue conditions, served through an interactive Streamlit app.
projects.longDescription: A player management and roster-optimization system for the Boston Bruins that combines SQL and MongoDB to track player statistics and recommends the best lineup based on performance, opponent strength, and venue conditions, served through an interactive Streamlit app.

projects.title: F1 Data Analysis
projects.description: A SQL and Tableau analysis of Formula 1 racing data from 1953–2020, modeling race results, driver and team performance, and circuit details to visualize historical trends and key performance metrics.
projects.longDescription: A SQL and Tableau analysis of Formula 1 racing data from 1953–2020, modeling race results, driver and team performance, and circuit details to visualize historical trends and key performance metrics.

projects.title: Nursing Home Financial Analysis
projects.description: An analysis of U.S. nursing homes' financial performance, quality indicators, and regulatory penalties from 2015–2021 using multiple CMS datasets, with a focus on the impact of COVID-19 on net income, staffing, and operations across facility sizes.
projects.longDescription: An analysis of U.S. nursing homes' financial performance, quality indicators, and regulatory penalties from 2015–2021 using multiple CMS datasets, with a focus on the impact of COVID-19 on net income, staffing, and operations across facility sizes.

projects.title: Car Dealership Dashboard
projects.description: A car-dealership analytics and prediction dashboard built in R that forecasts car prices, segments customers, and optimizes inventory, presenting interactive visualizations to support pricing strategy and business operations.
projects.longDescription: A car-dealership analytics and prediction dashboard built in R that forecasts car prices, segments customers, and optimizes inventory, presenting interactive visualizations to support pricing strategy and business operations.

projects.title: Sales Insights (SQL)
projects.description: A Power BI sales and revenue dashboard connected directly to a MySQL database that analyzes performance across markets, customers, products, and regions, consolidating multi-currency sales into a unified INR view for clearer financial reporting.
projects.longDescription: A Power BI sales and revenue dashboard connected directly to a MySQL database that analyzes performance across markets, customers, products, and regions, consolidating multi-currency sales into a unified INR view for clearer financial reporting.

projects.title: COVID-19 Global Vaccine Tracker
projects.description: A Power BI dashboard tracking global COVID-19 vaccination trends — partially vs. fully vaccinated populations, regional disparities, and the correlation between GDP per capita and vaccination progress — to support data-driven distribution planning.
projects.longDescription: A Power BI dashboard tracking global COVID-19 vaccination trends — partially vs. fully vaccinated populations, regional disparities, and the correlation between GDP per capita and vaccination progress — to support data-driven distribution planning.

projects.title: YouTube Channel Insights
projects.description: A Power BI dashboard analyzing YouTube channel performance across views, likes, comments, and engagement for both videos and shorts, using ETL preprocessing to highlight underperforming content and the relationship between video length and views.
projects.longDescription: A Power BI dashboard analyzing YouTube channel performance across views, likes, comments, and engagement for both videos and shorts, using ETL preprocessing to highlight underperforming content and the relationship between video length and views.
